items.question: A prospect needs a Call 2 tomorrow morning and only the Master Calendar has availability. How should the rep book it?
items.goldAnswer: Create the appointment in Google Calendar, create a new Zoom meeting, and email the prospect the Zoom link.

v5.answer: Do not edit or use the Master Calendar; instead, manually create a Google Calendar appointment and Zoom meeting, then email the Zoom link to the prospect.
